events.title: Carvery Lunch
events.description: Join us at Maroochy RSL everyday for lunch in the Bistro for your choice of roast meat, seasonal vegetables, pan juice gravy and a bread roll for just $19.50 (members price). Along with our carvery lunch, all items on our Bistro Menu will be available too. If you would like to book the courtesy bus or a table, click here , or call our Reception Team on (07) 5443 2211. T&Cs apply.

events.title: Kids Eat Free
events.description: Sunday lunch at Maroochy RSL! Come on down to Maroochy RSL for lunch on a Sunday, the kids can eat for free AND we have free kids entertainment from 12pm -3pm. With every menu main adult meal purchased over $19, the kids (12 years and under) can get a kids’ meal for free. That includes dessert! This offer is only available for Sunday lunch between 11.30am to 2.30pm. T&Cs apply, excludes specials and some combo offers. Book a table for your lunch today. Book here .

events.title: Free Face Painting
events.description: Bring the kids to Maroochy RSL this Sunday for FREE face painting! Face painting will be located in front of the Kidzone from 12pm to 3pm.

events.title: Marty Sima
events.description: Marty Sima is an experienced acoustic guitarist and singer known for delivering polished, feel-good covers of popular favourites. With a warm vocal style and confident musicianship, Marty creates engaging live performances that suit relaxed listening or upbeat social atmospheres. His repertoire spans decades and genres, reimagined with an acoustic edge that feels both familiar and fresh. Professional, reliable, and easy to work with, Marty brings quality sound, strong crowd connection, and a genuine love of live music to every performance.

events.title: Mega Bingo
events.description: Mega Bingo will be held on Level 1, from 7pm until 9.30pm. Selling commences – 5.30pm Eyes down – 7pm Prizes are; $500 on 90 calls $1,500 treble on 90 calls $2,000 on 90 calls $500 on 90 calls $200 on 90 calls All jackpots must be won. There are 4 Lucky Door prizes and all raffle proceeds will go to our Spring Charity. Experience the best bingo in town with cash prizes to be won. If you haven’t played bingo before it is easy to pick up, and the bingo staff can show you how to play on the day. It is a great opportunity to bring friends or make new ones.
